newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Farm sales slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Farm sales slow.

text.p: Farm sales slowed as producers in the Northern Plains were busy with spring wheat seedings due to prospects of favorable weather.
"Farmers in the fields are scrambling to get planted, thus nothing is coming to the elevator," a Montana dealer said.
A Minnesota dealer said he thought spring wheat planting was lagging in South Dakota and was about 40 percent complete in North Dakota.

A North Dakota dealer in the recently flooded Red River Valley region said producers were waiting for the ground to dry out. "But in the western and southern part of the state, they are ahead of us," the dealer said.
Dark northern spring wheat bids were mostly higher while soft white bids fell.
